title: Primary-source-bound FMC falling-slug to groundwater-front merge transition
purpose: Test the first surface-groundwater transition deliberately excluded from D17: a D16-style falling slug contacting and merging into a D13-style groundwater front under the primary Ogden et al. 2015 finite-volume merge rule.

predecessor_authority.D14: Eq.19 falling-slug translation conserves slug length and finite-volume water.
predecessor_authority.D15: Synthetic same-bin slug-groundwater merge and surface accounting ledger pass.
predecessor_authority.D16: Surface pulse/hiatus falling-slug development branch retained candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D17: Simultaneous separated surface and groundwater branches retained candidacy; minimum gap remained positive.
predecessor_authority.implication: D18 adds only the previously excluded contact/merge transition; it does not retune bins, process step, constitutive laws, front velocities, lambda or D17 pulse forcing.

rules: falling slugs advance by Eq.19 while preserving length
a falling slug that encounters a groundwater front during a time step is merged into that groundwater front
the groundwater front is raised toward the surface by an amount equal to the merged slug length in that bin
groundwater fronts advance or retreat by Eq.21 under a fixed-head lower boundary
primary_source_authority.bounded_implementation_note: D18 preserves the admitted D16 slug-translation representation and D13 groundwater-front relaxation. It does not introduce a new generalized falling-slug relaxation operator; the contact/merge event itself is the new operation under test.

stage1_event_preflight.initial_state: Reproduce the admitted D17 C75_G25 FMC state after exactly 16 continuous 10-s steps at top supply 0.75*Ksat, with D16 I_DEEP surface fronts and D13 G25 groundwater fronts.
stage1_event_preflight.transition_surface_flux: q_top = K(theta_i), where i=100. The entire 10-s supply equals the frozen gray-bin direct-throughflow demand, leaving zero residual supply for connected surface fronts.
stage1_event_preflight.detachment: At the first transition step, all remaining surface-connected wetted intervals detach into falling slugs with unchanged lengths, as in the admitted D15/D16 hiatus representation.
per_step_order: route q_top*dt = K(theta_i)*dt as gray-bin direct downward exchange
advance every surviving falling slug by Eq.19 for 10 s, preserving its length

for each bin whose translated slug bottom reaches or passes the top of the same-bin groundwater interval, merge the entire slug into the groundwater front by H_j <- H_j + slug_length and remove that slug
require every merged H_j finite, positive and <=160 cm; no clipping
advance all groundwater fronts by the admitted D13 Eq.21 forward-Euler 10-s step
apply the admitted D13 conservative groundwater-front relaxation
require every remaining slug and groundwater interval physical and nonoverlapping
ledger bottom-outward exchange = gray direct throughflow - groundwater-front storage change; require delta storage + bottom-outward exchange = 0 within 1e-12 cm
stage1_event_preflight.event_locator: earliest 10-s transition step with at least one same-bin slug-groundwater merge
pass_requirements: D17 reconstruction identity passes before transition
at least one merge occurs within 512 transition steps
the first merge changes no finite-volume water except declared boundary exchange
no groundwater front exceeds the column depth
no surviving slug overlaps a groundwater interval after merge
all step ledgers close within 1e-12 cm
no hidden correction, clipping or full-order fallback
stage1_event_preflight.failure_rule: Any failure closes D18 before R16/R2 transition trajectories. Do not change the pulse factor, G25 lambda, q_top=K(theta_i), bin count, process step, equations or event horizon inside D18.

stage2_if_preflight_passes.authorization: A pre-SWAP execution amendment may record the FMC-only first-contact step and freeze a matched comparator window without changing any physical rule.
stage2_if_preflight_passes.matched_history: Start R16/R2 from the exact cell-average mapping of the FMC state eight 10-s steps before first merge when available; otherwise from transition step 0. Run through first merge plus sixteen post-merge steps.
stage2_if_preflight_passes.boundaries: top prescribed downward q=K(theta_i); bottom fixed zero pressure head; no root sink, ET, drainage, subsurface irrigation, ponding or runoff.
metrics: FMC mass residual and merge count
positive_rule: event preflight passed before SWAP trajectory exposure
matched R16/R2 window completes with integrity
FMC total-storage and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE <= R2
FMC mapped R16-cell theta RMSE <= R2
FMC terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and FMC sign-error count <= R2

explicit_nonclaims: multiple repeated merge events under arbitrary rainfall
